description: Bulk-delete posts matching a filter — e.g. every draft in a campaign. SAFETY: a filter is required (it will never delete everything), published and processing posts are always excluded, and it runs as a DRY RUN unless confirm:true. Always call once without confirm to see what matches, show the user, then confirm.

campaign.description: Delete posts tagged with this campaign, e.g. 'garmin-cirqa-2026'

confirm.description: false/omitted = dry run listing what WOULD be deleted. true = actually delete. Always dry-run first.

label.description: Delete posts whose internal label matches (case-insensitive substring)

status.description: Restrict to one status, e.g. 'draft'. Defaults to everything except published/processing.

name: delete_posts
